entry_points.text: Dequeue, yield, preemption, migration, balance and tick hooks join deadline bookkeeping to scheduling; tick re-arms only for earliest entities with runtime left.
Boot creates sched directory with tuning, feature, domain and per-CPU server subtrees; server files share logic; group and flags files expose mode and names.

exports.text: Server idle accounting, start, attach and swap plus common execution-time refresh are exported; other helpers here are file-local.
Root-domain join/clear, global validate/apply, bandwidth alloc/free and housekeeping query are exported; global ops visit each domain once.
Parameter store copies runtime/deadline/period with masked flags and derived ratios; dynamic fetch returns live runtime and adjusted deadline.
Scaling/cache refresh, task statistics reset and share-mode selection are exported.
Arena pool lifecycle with sleeping alloc/free plus growth, and CID table publish/retire with deferred reclamation, are exported.

hazards.text: Task references are held across lock-releasing searches; timer release may destroy the task; cached queue data must not be reused after relock.
Join with no active CPU in the mask is fatal; affinity change on non-deadline tasks warns once; validation may transiently fail during bandwidth moves.
Debug writes fail cleanly with distinct errors; server show reads unlocked; offline checks can race; silent subtree failures and pool-growth cleanup apply.

invariants.text: Earlier absolute deadline means higher urgency for queue order, next-entity choice and pushable scan; priority query returns the entity deadline.
Push needs queued-not-running state with destination affinity; entry/exit updates pushable tracking; push drains until idle with woken gating.
Servers need inactive state, nonzero runtime and attached bandwidth; attach is idempotent and swap detaches first; effective mask honors housekeeping.
Wakeup keeps earlier deadlines local when the incumbent cannot move or is preemptible, else redirects; equal deadlines use migratability; fork noops; throttle reads the flag.
High-resolution tick has active and inert variants gated on activity, timer capability and feature flag; yield refreshes clocks so throttling follows.
Debug controls toggle named features, validate scaling/cache/preemption inputs and gate verbose state; unknown names and bad values fail.
Server runtime must fit within bounded period; install targets an online CPU with clock refresh and restart, warning on disable.
Group mode defaults to concur, accepts short names, rejects unknown ones, installs before publishing, mapping indices to up/smp/concur/max/tasks.
CID shards spread cores evenly with atomic sizing and shared publication; arena uses small pieces with paged growth; debug position zero is the header then ascending CPUs.

locks.text: Paired runqueue locking follows global queue order with nesting, releasing the held queue on order inversion and reporting release.
Push, pull and balance may drop queue locks and must revalidate afterward; migration holds the task-queue lock while refreshing clocks.
Bandwidth and domain accounting serializes on bandwidth locks during attach, swap, affinity, join, clear and validate.
Feature writes bound input and serialize under hotplug read lock with inode lock; cache refresh orders hotplug read outermost then domains mutex.
Server updates hold the runqueue lock with interrupts masked; CID publish needs the enable mutex with retire adding hotplug exclusion; arena alloc may sleep.

state_machines.text: Server expiry separates inapplicable, idle-deferred, background-deferred and replenish states; task expiry adds delegation, dormant, offline-migration and runnable cases.
Inactivity expiry separates server/task ownership, dead or retyped tasks and contending use; next-task resolution separates empty, server-delegated and direct outcomes.
Online restores overload and publishes earliest deadline, offline clears both; class switch handles non-contending timers and push/reschedule; deadline moves pull or reschedule.

structs.text: Runqueues carry current/donor tasks, deadline subqueue and overload state; deadline subqueue is ordered with cached leftmost; bandwidth requests are deactivate/alloc/release.
Push/pull search retries at most three times; defer granularity is one millisecond; server period spans one hundred microseconds to about four seconds in nanoseconds.
Deadline selector uses zero for runtime and one for period; arena uses order-three minimum with four-page growth; topology sentinel is minus one.
Global CID state exposes six RCU mappings for forward, reverse, shard, node, range and topology.
